document.scope: Pre-registration of the smallest defensible recording experiment able to collect the neural-level data missing from the Phase 6B and 6C analyses. No simulation, recording, training or instrumentation was performed.
non_claims: Mutual information does not establish causation.
A decoder label does not establish a motor command.
A simulated spike is not a biological spike.
A positive propagation pilot does not establish that the fly behaves the same way.
A structural edge does not establish functional transmission.

protocol.strategy_justification: The missing data are simulated neural-level data, not biological data. Option B (biological recording) would require a preparation, region and stimulus protocol that no prior phase has established.

stages.purpose: BANC recording campaign at the pilot-selected drive
stages.gate_to_next: recording integrity and Stage S check

stages.purpose: fixed-versus-plastic neural recording on the Phase 5 substrate

pilot.d_star_rule: lowest drive meeting P1, fixed before any H2, DESC or decoder outcome is examined

gates.name: integrity
gates.pass: all 324 records complete every mandatory field; 5% re-run reproduces spike_hash; no SpikeCapacityExceeded; all membrane arrays finite

gates.name: first-hop spiking
gates.pass: at some drive d, at least 10 of 20 REAL trials have >=1 H1 spike, NO_STIM and MATCHED_CHARGE each have <=1 of 20, one-sided Fisher p < 0.01; d* = lowest such drive
gates.fail: if no drive up to 1200 pA passes and DIRECT_INJECTION also fails, stop; if DIRECT_INJECTION at >=400 pA spikes H1 while REAL does not, report drive/encoder failure and stop

gates.name: propagation-positive
gates.pass: at d*, at least 3 of 20 REAL trials have >=1 spike in H2 union DESC, and 0 of 40 control trials has any downstream spike
gates.fail: stop; Stage R and all Phase 6D MI analyses are cancelled, not postponed

gates.name: decoder reachability
gates.pass: at d*, at least one post-stimulus REAL decoder window is non-NEUTRAL and no control window is non-NEUTRAL
gates.fail: not fatal; H5 declared untestable and removed from the confirmatory family

recruitment_code.note: edges depend on population size alone, so the code cannot be selected after seeing results

stimulus_code.split_rule: entity x distance half at the pooled archived median 0.653686
stimulus_code.event_assignment: declared round-robin from the sorted event list

hypotheses.level: sensory input to stimulated sensory neurons
hypotheses.claim: the declared stimulus code is reflected in the activity of the stimulated sensory population

response.name: R_STIM
response.definition: recruitment code of STIM in [50,300) ms

hypotheses.support_criterion: corrected I > 0.05 bits above permutation q95, trial-resampled bootstrap CI excluding zero, at least two observed levels in both variables
inconclusive_if: a stimulus level has fewer than 20 trials
the two sparsest stimulus levels contribute more than half of the estimate

hypotheses.level: sensory neurons to downstream first-hop populations
hypotheses.claim: first-hop activity depends on the pattern of stimulated sensory activity, not merely on the presence of stimulation
hypotheses.null: I(R_STIM; R_H1) = 0 and REAL H1 rate equals NO_STIM and MATCHED_CHARGE
hypotheses.alternative: I(R_STIM; R_H1) > 0 and REAL H1 rate exceeds both controls
hypotheses.support_criterion: H1 information criterion plus propagation criterion P2
inconclusive_if: H1 silent in every REAL trial
H1 active in NO_STIM at a rate not separable from REAL at N=672
fewer than two observed recruitment levels

hypotheses.claim: descending-neuron activity depends on first-hop activity
hypotheses.null: I(R_H1; R_DESC) = 0 and REAL DESC rate equals NO_STIM
hypotheses.alternative: I(R_H1; R_DESC) > 0 and REAL DESC rate exceeds NO_STIM
controls: report only 9 of 1316 descending neurons are first-hop targets
hypotheses.support_criterion: corrected MI > 0.05 bits above permutation q95 with CI excluding zero, and >=1 descending spike in at least 15% of REAL trials (3 of 20 pilot, 100 of 672)
inconclusive_if: P2 fails in which case H3 is NOT TESTABLE
fewer than 20 trials contain a descending spike

hypotheses.claim: motor-population activity depends on descending activity
hypotheses.null: I(R_DESC; R_MOT) = 0 and REAL MOT rate equals NO_STIM
hypotheses.alternative: I(R_DESC; R_MOT) > 0 and REAL MOT rate exceeds NO_STIM
controls: annotation mapping has zero first-hop motor targets and only 4 motor neurons at two signed hops
hypotheses.support_criterion: corrected MI > 0.05 bits above permutation q95 with CI excluding zero, and >=1 motor spike in at least 15% of REAL trials (3 of 20 pilot, 100 of 672)
inconclusive_if: P2 fails in which case H4 is NOT TESTABLE
no motor neuron spikes in any REAL trial, reported as a bounded null rather than an information test

hypotheses.level: neural population activity to decoder-mediated action
hypotheses.claim: the decoder per-window decision is a deterministic function of declared pool activity; a consistency claim about a rule, not about motor control

response.name: A
response.definition: last non-NEUTRAL decoder state in [50,300) ms, else NEUTRAL

hypotheses.alternative: I(R_MOT; A) > 0; a positive result is expected whenever the decoder fires at all because it reads the same spikes
controls: NEUTRAL required in all control conditions
hypotheses.support_criterion: correctly labelled estimate only; can never support a motor-control or biological claim
inconclusive_if: every window NEUTRAL in every condition, which makes the endpoint degenerate

hypotheses.level: neural activity and task outcome under fixed versus plastic weights
hypotheses.substrate: Phase 5 synthetic 36-node task graph, not BANC
hypotheses.claim: plastic training changes the neural code that carries cue identity relative to fixed weights

response.name: A_neural
response.definition: action neuron with the highest evaluation spike count, fifth level for none, ties resolved to the lowest index

hypotheses.null: I(CUE; A_neural) is equal in fixed_complete and plastic_complete
hypotheses.alternative: pooled I(CUE; A_neural) is greater after plasticity
hypotheses.support_criterion: paired cluster-level difference has bootstrap CI excluding zero and exceeds 0.05 bits in the predicted direction
inconclusive_if: per-seed action code degenerate for more than 20% of seeds
row-level and cluster-level analyses disagree in sign

conditions.role: uniform total charge equal to mean REAL charge

controls.name: spontaneous baseline
controls.rules_out: downstream spikes are spontaneous rather than stimulus-locked

controls.name: matched charge
controls.rules_out: response is driven by total current rather than its pattern
controls.known_weakness: uniform spread is roughly 46.7 pA per neuron at Phase 4H scale and may be subthreshold

controls.name: shuffled feature identity
controls.rules_out: downstream activity is generic arousal to any sensory input

controls.name: direct first-hop injection
controls.rules_out: null propagation is caused by the sensory drive rather than the H1 to H2 synapse

controls.name: single first-hop spike
controls.rules_out: propagation requires many simultaneous H1 spikes by model construction

controls.name: fixed-weight paired condition
controls.rules_out: Stage S difference is caused by seed or protocol rather than plasticity

controls.name: eta-zero reproduction
controls.rules_out: stored evaluation traces were altered by the evaluation itself

controls.name: decoder neutrality in controls
controls.rules_out: the decoder fires on noise or uniform charge

controls.name: label permutation null
controls.rules_out: observed MI is expected from marginal distributions alone

controls.name: seed-pair reproducibility
controls.rules_out: an effect is carried by a small number of seeds

controls.name: blinded analysis
controls.rules_out: analyst degrees of freedom in choosing the reported comparison

controls.name: decoder ablation
controls.rules_out: the H5 estimate reflects something other than the decoder wiring
controls.method: seeded permutation of neuron-to-pool assignment on stored spikes

variables.dense_formats: excluded by design; the largest mandatory array is 7 populations x 30 bins

sample_size.n_derivation: N >= 648 from the 6x4 floor <= 0.0167; the smallest multiple of 4 and 6 above 648 is 672

rejected_sample.reason: floor is more than three times the MDE; not reused as evidence of power

sample_size.event_cluster_bound: generalisation is limited to the 43 archived feature-carrying events; OBST_NEAR has 2

estimators.entropy: plugin H = -sum p log2 p with Miller-Madow (K_obs-1)/(2N ln2) reported alongside
estimators.mutual_information: plugin I with bias floor (kx-1)(ky-1)/(2N ln2), I_corrected = max(0, I - floor)
estimators.conditional_mi: sample-weighted mean of within-stratum MI with per-stratum bias floor
estimators.nmi: reported only when both entropies exceed 0.05 bits

response_stim_h1_h2_desc.rule: absolute spike count, fixed in advance

inference.multiple_comparisons: Holm-Bonferroni over the gate-unlocked family, alpha 0.05

data_handling.missing_data: no imputation; exclusion counted; more than 5% exclusion in any condition is an integrity failure
data_handling.degenerate_variable: single observed level is reported as degenerate or inconclusive, never as a negative
data_handling.locked_endpoints: endpoints not unlocked by a gate are reported as not evaluated, never as non-significant

execution_order: evaluate P1 then P2 then P3 and freeze d_star
run Stage R analysis on unlocked conditions
write and hash the results file before prose
guardrails: significant MI does not establish a biological mechanism
a decoder output does not establish motor control
zero downstream spikes is degenerate, not negative
Stage S is never pooled with Stage R
a reversed Stage S direction is reported as found

endpoints.estimand: proportion of trials with >=1 H1 spike
median H1 spike count per trial
endpoints.test: Mann-Whitney U with trial bootstrap CI

endpoints.estimand: proportion of trials with >=1 H2 or DESC spike

endpoints.test: corrected MI with permutation and event-cluster bootstrap

endpoints.estimand: I(stimulus level; H2 response | H1 recruited)
proportion of DESC spikes followed by a MOT spike within 5 ms
endpoints.test: trial-clustered proportion with MOT timing permutation
corrected MI, only admissible as a decoder-consistency statement

endpoints.estimand: paired difference in I(cue; A_neural) plastic minus fixed
endpoints.test: cluster bootstrap CI on the paired difference

recording_integrity.pass: >=99.5% of trials complete every mandatory field, 5% re-run reproduces spike_hash, archived 4H hash reproduced, no capacity exceeded, all membrane arrays finite
recording_integrity.fail: unexplained determinism mismatch, silent truncation, or >5% missing mandatory fields in any condition

reproducibility.pass: analysis reproduces every number within 1e-9 and 20/20 seed halves agree in sign
reproducibility.fail: a number changes after freezing, or halves disagree in sign on a confirmatory endpoint
reproducibility.inconclusive: sign disagreement is reported for that endpoint only

stimulus_encoding.pass: E1 passes and E2 shows a higher median H1 count in REAL
stimulus_encoding.fail: REAL and controls at the same floor while DIRECT_INJECTION shows H1 can spike
stimulus_encoding.inconclusive: effect requires DIRECT_INJECTION success to interpret, or is carried by one seed half

downstream_propagation.pass: P2 passes and E3 exceeds both SHUFFLED_MASK and MATCHED_CHARGE
downstream_propagation.fail: P2 fails at every drive up to 1200 pA, or E3 equals controls
downstream_propagation.inconclusive: REAL exceeds NO_STIM but not MATCHED_CHARGE, or SHUFFLED_MASK equals REAL, or all channels degenerate

population_information.pass: E5 survives Holm with event-cluster CI excluding zero and support met
population_information.fail: E5 estimable and indistinguishable from the permutation null
population_information.inconclusive: not estimable, or significant at trial level only

neural_to_motor_information.pass: E7 or E8 survives Holm and P3 passed; still labelled decoder-mediated
neural_to_motor_information.fail: P3 passed but E7 and E8 at the null
neural_to_motor_information.inconclusive: P3 failed, making the endpoint untestable

plasticity_neural_change.pass: Phase 5F contrast reproduced at 40 seeds and E10 difference exceeds 0.05 bits with CI excluding zero
plasticity_neural_change.fail: contrast reproduced but E10 difference below 0.05 bits or CI contains zero
plasticity_neural_change.inconclusive: contrast not reproduced, >20% of seeds degenerate, or row and cluster signs disagree

task_performance.pass: plastic_complete exceeds fixed_complete by a paired difference with CI excluding zero in the Phase 5F direction
task_performance.fail: no difference or a reversed difference, reported as found
task_performance.inconclusive: not applicable; this is a reproduction check

phase_verdict_rules.verdict: negative on propagation, consistent with Phase 4H.4

phase_verdict_rules.condition: P2 passes but E4 and E5 null
P2 and E5 pass but P3 fails
phase_verdict_rules.verdict: information reaches downstream populations; decoder does not

phase_verdict_rules.condition: P2, E5 and P3 pass but E7 and E8 null

phase_verdict_rules.verdict: computational information flow established in the model at evidence grade at most E2
E10 skipped; Stage R verdict stands independently

resources.concurrency: single process by default; concurrency only if free memory exceeds 1.5 GiB

risks.risk: propagation never appears at any drive up to 1200 pA
risks.residual: a true rate near 20% can still be missed; P2 sensitivity 0.79

risks.risk: descending and motor populations structurally unreachable
only 43 of 215 events carry feature values; OBST_NEAR has 2
the step wrapper changes simulator behaviour
risks.mitigation: C8 archive replay and 5% determinism re-runs
risks.residual: deterministic change would pass the hash test

risks.risk: bias floor approximation for sparse tables
risks.mitigation: report raw, floor, corrected and CI
risks.residual: estimate near the MDE could be materially wrong
reader may view selection as partially adaptive

risks.risk: MATCHED_CHARGE spread uniformly may be subthreshold
risks.mitigation: report per-neuron amplitude and treat a null as uninformative if below rheobase

risks.risk: NO_STIM with 50 pA noise produced zero spikes in 4H
risks.mitigation: P2 uses 0 of 40 as a screen

risks.risk: Stage S uses a different substrate

risks.mitigation: archive replay, determinism and estimator tests

risks.risk: a pathological run stalls the campaign
risks.residual: lost trial reported as missing data

risks.impact: E8/E9 cannot support a motor claim
risks.mitigation: labelled decoder-mediated and excluded from the verdict above E2

risks.risk: no neuromodulation, adaptation or cell-type conductances

approval_gates.name: protocol
approval_gates.requires: this document and JSON reviewed and accepted, including the three scope decisions
approval_gates.artifact: signed note and frozen protocol sha256

approval_gates.name: instrumentation
approval_gates.requires: G0 passed; approval to write code and tests only, no simulations
approval_gates.artifact: code diff restricted to phase_6d paths and config

approval_gates.name: instrumentation validated
approval_gates.requires: G1 passed; full test suite passes; archived 4H condition-B spike hash reproduced; no production module changed
approval_gates.artifact: test log, hash equality, clean git status

approval_gates.name: pilot
approval_gates.requires: G2 passed; approval to run Stage P

approval_gates.name: gate decision
approval_gates.requires: Stage P complete; P0-P3 evaluated in order; d_star fixed

approval_gates.name: campaign
approval_gates.artifact: Stage R manifest or a recorded not-reached decision

approval_gates.name: analysis and report
approval_gates.requires: all runs complete and frozen; analysis run once; results frozen before prose
approval_gates.artifact: results JSON sha256 and discrepancy log

next_actions: review this protocol and resolve the three scope decisions
G1: write the instrumentation and tests listed in the resource section
G2: validate against the archived 4H spike hash and run the full test suite
G3-G4: run Stage P, evaluate P0-P3, freeze d_star
stop and report if P2 is not positive, preserving Phase 4H and 4H.5 conclusions
G5: run Stage R if P2 passed
G6: run Stage S if in scope and the Phase 5F contrast reproduces
G7: run the analysis once, freeze results, write the report
scope_decisions_open: enable optional panel diagnostics (about 1.4 GB extra storage, no confirmatory endpoint) or keep the sparse record
accept the four-point drive series or run a finer threshold calibration as a separate prerequisite
keep Stage S in Phase 6D or defer it to its own phase
limitations: the propagation-positive gate may fail at every tested drive
the motor pools are structurally unreachable from the annotation mapping, so H4 and H5 will probably be untestable
membrane and synaptic-current recording is possible only through an instance-level wrapper on a declared panel
the archived stimulus corpus has few distinct obstacle events
H6 runs on a different substrate from H1-H5
out_of_scope: No simulation, recording, training, architecture change or instrumentation was performed. Only this JSON and its Markdown companion were created.
